posts.name: Agnivesh Jyotiraditya Kannankara
posts.cooked:
Hello,
Needed to clarify a few things regarding the VM that is going to be used for OPPE.

  1. So the VM for the OPPE going to be same different from the current NPPE VM as I understand?
  2. So in that case, will there be any additional time or such to log in and set up the environment like bashrc configs and similar things?

Kindly clarify when available to do so.
@sayan

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
We will send an email by tonight about OPPE VM, there is a slight change in domain. Rest process remains same. You might have to re-upload your ssh key.

You can login 1 hour before exam to do setup.

posts.name: Agnivesh Jyotiraditya Kannankara
posts.cooked:
Thanks for the quick response, that cleared up most of the doubts
Also:

There’s no issue with copying config code to the VM, right? Primarily planning to use those provided in the suggested code from the official channel such as es, ptc, etc.

And should we join the oppe google meet before starting doing the setup or can we do it after that?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Configuration is allowed. We will provide some by default as well. You can customize as per your requirement.

This is not proctored, so does not matter when you do it.
